versions.changelog:
Initial release of weather-query skill for QWeather integration.

- Provides real-time weather and forecasts using QWeather API (JWT+Host).
- Supports queries by city name, LocationID, or latitude/longitude.
- Allows “today/tomorrow/the day after/future N days” forecast expressions.
- Automatically resolves location input or uses QWEATHER_DEFAULT_LOCATION if set.
- Returns comprehensive weather details: condition, temperature, humidity, wind, observation time, and daily forecast highlights.
- Outputs clear errors with env variable guidance on API failure.
